) format('woff2');}
@font-face{font-family:'Poppins';font-weight:700;font-style:normal;font-display:swap;src:url(data:font/woff2;base64,) format('woff2');}
:root{
  --hp-purple:#5A50E6;
  --hp-purple-dark:#221C4A;
  --hp-purple-light:#EEEBFB;
  --hp-purple-mid:#B3A7EE;
  --hp-purple-border:#D9D2F6;
  --hp-purple-text:#221C4A;
  --hp-violet:#8B5CF6;
  --hp-lilac:#C4B5FD;
  --hp-grad:linear-gradient(135deg,#5A50E6 0%,#8B5CF6 100%);

  --text-primary:#1B1B22;
  --text-secondary:#5C5B66;
  --text-muted:#8F8E98;

  --surface-0:#3A2352;
  --surface-1:#FFFFFF;
  --surface-2:#FFFFFF;
  --surface-3:#F3F3F4;
  --border:#E6E6E9;
  --border-strong:#D9D9DD;
  --radius:12px;

  --bg-success:#E7FBEF;
  --text-success:#187F44;
  --border-success:#BEEBD1;
  --fill-success:#1F9D55;

  --bg-warning:#FFF4E5;
  --text-warning:#9C6A1A;
  --border-warning:#F5DDB0;
  --fill-warning:#E9A23B;

  --bg-danger:#FDECEF;
  --text-danger:#C43A54;
  --border-danger:#F5CDD6;
  --fill-danger:#E5556E;

  --phonics-font:'Andika','Comic Sans MS',sans-serif;
}
html,body{background:var(--surface-0);}
body{
  font-family:'Nunito',-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Segoe UI",Roboto,Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif;
  color:var(--text-primary);
  min-height:100vh;
}
a{color:var(--hp-purple);text-decoration:none;}
input,select,button,textarea{font-family:inherit;}
input,select,textarea{
  padding:0.5rem 0.6rem;
  border:0.5px solid var(--border-strong);
  border-radius:var(--radius);
  background:var(--surface-1);
  color:var(--text-primary);
  width:100%;
}
textarea{resize:vertical;min-height:90px;}
input:focus,select:focus,textarea:focus{outline:2px solid var(--hp-purple-mid);outline-offset:1px;}
.sr-only{position:absolute;width:1px;height:1px;padding:0;margin:-1px;overflow:hidden;clip:rect(0,0,0,0);white-space:nowrap;border:0;}
.page{max-width:900px;margin:0 auto;padding:2rem 1rem 4rem;}
.wrap{padding:1rem 0;max-width:860px;margin:0 auto;}
.screen{display:none;}
.screen.active{display:block;}
.rv-screen{display:none;}
.rv-screen.active{display:block;}
.maths-check-block{display:none;}
.maths-check-block.active{display:block;}
.play-screen{display:none;}
.play-screen.active{display:block;}
.practice-screen{display:none;}
.practice-screen.active{display:block;}
.parent-screen{display:none;}
.parent-screen.active{display:block;}
.parent-pointer-row{display:flex;align-items:baseline;gap:8px;padding:0.35rem 0;font-size:14px;}
.parent-pointer-row + .parent-pointer-row{border-top:0.5px solid var(--border-strong);}
.parent-pointer-subject{font-weight:600;color:var(--hp-purple-dark);}
.lr-row{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px;padding:0.6rem 0.75rem;border:0.5px solid var(--border-strong);border-radius:var(--radius);background:var(--surface-2);margin-bottom:0.5rem;}
.lr-row-text{font-size:13px;color:var(--text-primary);flex:1;}
.lr-row.lr-swapped{border-color:var(--hp-purple);background:var(--surface-1);}
.mm-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);gap:10px;margin-top:0.5rem;}
@media (min-width:520px){.mm-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);}}
.mm-card{min-height:78px;border-radius:12px;border:1px solid var(--border-strong);background:var(--surface-2);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;text-align:center;padding:8px;font-size:12.5px;font-weight:500;line-height:1.3;cursor:pointer;transition:transform 0.15s,background 0.15s,border-color 0.15s;color:var(--text-primary);}
.mm-card:active{transform:scale(0.97);}
.mm-card.mm-hidden{font-size:24px;color:var(--hp-purple);}
.mm-card.mm-revealed{background:#fff;border-color:var(--hp-purple);}
.mm-card.mm-matched{background:#e9f9ee;border-color:#34a853;color:#1e7e37;cursor:default;}
.live-progress-bg{width:80px;height:6px;background:var(--surface-3);border-radius:3px;overflow:hidden;flex-shrink:0;}
.live-progress-fill{height:100%;background:var(--hp-purple);transition:width 0.3s;}
.live-status-badge{font-size:11px;padding:2px 8px;border-radius:99px;background:var(--surface-2);color:var(--text-secondary);white-space:nowrap;}
.brand-header{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;margin-bottom:1.25rem;padding-bottom:1rem;border-bottom:0.5px solid var(--border-strong);}
.brand-badge{width:38px;height:38px;border-radius:10px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;flex-shrink:0;overflow:hidden;}
.brand-title{font-size:30px;font-weight:700;color:#3A3340;font-family:'Caveat',cursive;line-height:1;}
.brand-sub{font-size:12px;color:var(--text-muted);margin-top:1px;}
.brand-lockup{position:relative;background:#3A2352;border-radius:18px;padding:1.5rem 1rem 1.25rem;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;text-align:center;margin-bottom:1.25rem;}
.brand-lockup-icon{width:60px;height:60px;margin-bottom:2px;}
.brand-lockup-word{font-family:'Caveat',cursive;font-weight:700;font-size:34px;color:#FCFAFE;line-height:1;}
.brand-lockup-sub{font-size:12px;color:rgba(255,255,255,0.62);margin-top:3px;}
.brand-lockup-corner{position:absolute;top:14px;right:16px;font-size:13px;color:#C8A6FF;font-weight:600;}
.page-dark{background:#3A2352;width:100vw;margin-left:calc(50% - 50vw);margin-right:calc(50% - 50vw);margin-top:-2rem;margin-bottom:-4rem;padding:2rem 1rem 4rem;box-sizing:border-box;}
.page-dark.full-bleed{min-height:100vh;}
.page-dark .brand-lockup{background:none;padding:1.5rem 0 0.5rem;border-radius:0;margin-bottom:0.25rem;}
/* #app-view isn't a .page-dark screen, but its header brand-lockup sits on the same dark purple background - without this its own solid #3A2352 fill (matching but opaque) silently hides the decorative icons rendered underneath it. */
#app-view .brand-lockup{background:none;}
.page-dark .hero-title{color:#FCFAFE;}
.page-dark .hero-sub{color:rgba(255,255,255,0.78);}
.page-dark .back-link{color:#C8A6FF;}
.page-dark .mini-link{color:#C8A6FF;}
.page-dark .auth-tab{color:rgba(255,255,255,0.55);}
.page-dark .auth-tab.active{color:#FFFFFF;border-bottom-color:#C8A6FF;}
.page-dark .landing-stat-val{color:#FCFAFE;}
.page-dark .landing-stat-lbl{color:rgba(255,255,255,0.62);}
.page-dark .site-footer{color:rgba(255,255,255,0.5);}
h1,h2,h3{font-family:'Poppins',-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Segoe UI",Roboto,Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif;}
h2{font-size:16px;font-weight:600;color:var(--text-primary);margin-bottom:0.75rem;}
p{font-size:15px;color:var(--text-secondary);line-height:1.6;margin-bottom:0.75rem;}
.card{background:var(--surface-2);border:0.5px solid var(--border);border-radius:16px;padding:1.25rem;margin-bottom:1rem;box-shadow:0 10px 30px rgba(40,30,90,.05);}
.nav-tabs{display:flex;border-bottom:0.5px solid var(--border-strong);margin-bottom:1rem;overflow-x:auto;-webkit-overflow-scrolling:touch;scrollbar-width:none;}
.nav-tabs::-webkit-scrollbar{display:none;}
.nav-tab{padding:0.5rem 0.85rem;font-size:13px;cursor:pointer;color:rgba(255,255,255,0.55);border-bottom:2px solid transparent;margin-bottom:-1px;background:none;border-top:none;border-left:none;border-right:none;white-space:nowrap;transition:color 0.12s;flex:0 0 auto;}
.nav-tab.active{color:#C8A6FF;border-bottom-color:#C8A6FF;}
.nav-tab:hover{color:#FFFFFF;}
.content-shell{background:none;box-shadow:none;border-radius:0;padding:0.5rem 0 1.25rem;--text-primary:#F5F1FC;--text-secondary:rgba(245,241,252,0.78);--text-muted:rgba(245,241,252,0.58);--surface-2:transparent;--surface-3:rgba(255,255,255,0.10);--hp-purple-dark:#C8A6FF;color:var(--text-primary);}
.content-shell .card{background:none;border:none;box-shadow:none;border-radius:0;}
.content-shell h2{color:#F5F1FC;}
.content-shell .subject-card .subject-desc{color:#5C5B66;}
.content-shell .subject-banner{background:none;border:none;padding:0.8rem 0;}
.content-shell .subject-banner-title{color:#F5F1FC;}
.content-shell input,.content-shell select,.content-shell textarea,
.content-shell .all-btn,.content-shell .export-btn,.content-shell .icon-btn,
.content-shell .sort-select,.content-shell .report-term-select,
.content-shell .target-status-select,.content-shell .btn-ghost,
.content-shell .report-textarea,.content-shell .group-toggle-btn,
.content-shell .mode-btn,.content-shell .lr-row.lr-swapped,
.content-shell #report-modal-item,.content-shell #suggest-context-locked,
.content-shell #staff-owner-gone-note{--text-primary:#1B1B22;--text-secondary:#5C5B66;--text-muted:#8F8E98;--surface-3:#F3F3F4;}
.btn{width:100%;padding:0.7rem;border-radius:var(--radius);font-size:15px;font-weight:500;cursor:pointer;margin-top:0.5rem;transition:all 0.12s;border:0.5px solid var(--border-strong);}
.btn-primary{background:var(--hp-grad);color:#fff;border-color:transparent;box-shadow:0 6px 16px rgba(90,80,230,.28);}
.btn-primary:hover{filter:brightness(0.94);}
.btn-primary:disabled{opacity:0.6;cursor:default;}
.btn-ghost{background:var(--surface-1);color:var(--text-primary);}
.btn-ghost:hover{background:var(--surface-3);}
.phase-btn{width:100%;text-align:left;background:var(--surface-2);border:0.5px solid var(--border-strong);border-radius:var(--radius);padding:0.75rem 1rem;margin-bottom:0.5rem;cursor:pointer;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;transition:background 0.12s,border-color 0.12s;}
.phase-btn:hover{background:var(--surface-3);border-color:var(--hp-purple-mid);}
.phase-btn.active{background:var(--hp-purple-light);border-color:var(--hp-purple);}
.phase-badge{width:34px;height:34px;border-radius:50%;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:14px;font-weight:500;flex-shrink:0;background:var(--hp-purple);color:#fff;}
.phase-badge.avatar-badge{font-size:13px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:0.2px;color:#fff;}
.phase-badge:not(.avatar-badge){width:auto;height:auto;border-radius:0;background:none;color:var(--hp-purple);font-size:24px;}
.phase-name{font-size:15px;font-weight:500;color:var(--text-primary);font-family:'Poppins',-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Segoe UI",Roboto,Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif;}
.phase-desc{font-family:var(--phonics-font);font-size:12px;color:var(--text-secondary);margin-top:2px;}
.sound-display{font-family:var(--phonics-font);font-size:80px;font-weight:700;text-align:center;padding:1.5rem 0 1rem;color:#C8A6FF;line-height:1;}
.gr-question-display{font-family:var(--phonics-font);font-size:23px;font-weight:600;text-align:center;padding:1.25rem 0.5rem 0.25rem;color:#C8A6FF;line-height:1.4;}
.tts-btn{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:5px;margin:0.5rem auto 0;padding:0.4rem 0.9rem;border-radius:999px;border:1px solid var(--hp-purple-border);background:var(--hp-purple-light);color:var(--hp-purple);font-size:12.5px;font-weight:600;cursor:pointer;transition:background 0.12s,color 0.12s;}
.tts-btn:hover{background:var(--hp-purple);color:#fff;}
.tts-btn.speaking{background:var(--hp-purple);color:#fff;}
.content-shell .tts-btn{background:rgba(255,255,255,0.12);border-color:rgba(255,255,255,0.24);color:#F5F1FC;}
.content-shell .tts-btn:hover,.content-shell .tts-btn.speaking{background:var(--hp-purple);color:#fff;}
.pictogram-wrap{margin:0.75rem auto 0.25rem;max-width:420px;background:var(--surface-2);border:0.5px solid var(--border-strong);border-radius:var(--radius);padding:0.9rem 1rem;text-align:left;}
.pictogram-key{font-size:12.5px;color:var(--text-secondary);text-align:center;margin-bottom:0.7rem;font-weight:500;}
.pictogram-row{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;margin-bottom:8px;}
.pictogram-row:last-child{margin-bottom:0;}
.pictogram-row-label{font-size:13px;font-weight:600;color:var(--text-primary);flex-shrink:0;min-width:88px;}
.pictogram-icons{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:3px;font-size:19px;line-height:1;}
.pictogram-icon-half{display:inline-block;width:0.52em;overflow:hidden;}
.gr-answer-hint{font-size:13px;color:var(--text-muted);text-align:center;padding-bottom:0.75rem;}
.sound-counter{font-size:13px;color:var(--text-muted);text-align:center;margin-bottom:1rem;}
.progress-bar{height:4px;background:var(--surface-3);border-radius:2px;overflow:hidden;margin-bottom:1.25rem;}
.progress-fill{height:100%;border-radius:2px;transition:width 0.3s;background:var(--hp-purple);}
.yn-row{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:0.75rem;margin-top:0.5rem;}
.yn-btn{padding:1rem;border-radius:var(--radius);font-size:17px;font-weight:500;cursor:pointer;border:0.5px solid;transition:all 0.12s;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;}
.yn-yes{background:var(--bg-success);color:var(--text-success);border-color:var(--border-success);}
.yn-yes:hover{filter:brightness(0.97);}
.yn-no{background:var(--bg-danger);color:var(--text-danger);border-color:var(--border-danger);}
.yn-no:hover{filter:brightness(0.97);}
.mc-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:0.6rem;margin-top:0.75rem;}
.mc-grid-text{grid-template-columns:1fr;}
.mc-btn{padding:0.85rem 1rem;border-radius:var(--radius);font-size:15px;font-weight:500;cursor:pointer;border:0.5px solid var(--border-strong);background:var
